correction.what_was_wrong: Eight of the parity-odd CANDIDATES were not covariant contractions. A contraction is covariant only when each repeated index appears once UP and once DOWN, and these summed a pair over two lower or two upper slots with no metric between them. The defect lives in how a candidate is specified: each operand is a slot spec, and its VARIANCE is implicit in which pre-raised array the spec is handed. cu012 is C^{abc}_{d}; cu01 is C^{ab}_{cd}. Pass the wrong one, or transpose two free slots, and the spec still runs and still returns a number.
correction.why_no_check_caught_it: The conformal test compares g with e^{2 sigma} g where sigma vanishes at the base point. For a WEYL-built candidate that test is VACUOUS: C^{a}_{bcd} is conformally invariant with no derivative-of-sigma terms, so any product of Weyl tensors contracted in any index pattern passes it automatically. This certificate called those candidates "conformally invariant by construction" -- true, and exactly why the test could say nothing. The weight count cancels too, one down-down pair and one up-up pair contributing -2 and +2. Nothing ever asked whether a candidate was a TENSOR.

establishes: The PARITY-ODD pointwise conformal invariants of weight 6 -- those carrying one Levi-Civita tensor -- computed by exact rational rank over generated metrics. D = 4: 2. D = 6: 2. In ODD dimensions none exist, by index counting rather than by computation. The D = 4 parity result therefore DOES have a D = 6 analogue, and the gate's second question is answered YES. Both invariants in each dimension are EXHIBITED rather than merely counted: they are the complete contractions of one epsilon with three WEYL tensors, which carry conformal weight -6 uniformly and are therefore invariant by construction.

the_answer_to_the_gate.asked: whether the D = 4 parity result has a D = 6 analogue
the_answer_to_the_gate.answered: yes. There are parity-odd pointwise conformal invariants of weight 6 in D = 6, two of them are exhibited explicitly, and the D = 4 sector has two as well.
the_answer_to_the_gate.what_the_d4_parity_result_was: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1: W_+^2 = (C^2 + P)/2 and W_-^2 = (C^2 - P)/2 are both Weyl invariant, span a two-parameter family of ACTIONS and a one-parameter family of FIELD EQUATIONS, so RP-PARITY is independent on actions and redundant on field equations. That gate ASSERTS P is a pointwise conformal invariant; this one COMPUTES it.
the_answer_to_the_gate.the_shape_of_the_analogue: in both dimensions the parity-odd invariant content is exactly what the WEYL tensor supplies. The Riemann-built parity-odd candidates are mostly identically zero, and the ones that are not are not invariant on their own.

how_a_levi_civita_tensor_stays_in_exact_.the_problem: eps_{a_1..a_D} = sqrt(|det g|) [a_1..a_D], and that square root is not rational in general, which would put the entire parity-odd sector outside exact rational arithmetic
how_a_levi_civita_tensor_stays_in_exact_.the_resolution: evaluate at a base point where |det g| = 1, and the tensor IS the symbol there, exactly
how_a_levi_civita_tensor_stays_in_exact_.why_that_is_free: the fixtures are G = L S L^T with L unit lower-triangular over the integers, so det G = +/-1 by construction; and a conformal partner e^{2 sigma} g with sigma vanishing at the base point has the same determinant there
how_a_levi_civita_tensor_stays_in_exact_.it_is_checked_not_assumed: check 1 in each dimension verifies |det g| = 1 on every fixture. A mutation making the base metric non-unimodular scores 18/20, failing exactly that check in both dimensions.
how_a_levi_civita_tensor_stays_in_exact_.the_other_thing_that_makes_it_work: the Levi-Civita tensor is COVARIANTLY CONSTANT, so it passes straight through a covariant derivative and the derivative candidates need no extra machinery

method.candidate_specification: a parity-odd candidate is a SLOT SPEC: which of the operands' index slots feed the epsilon, and how the remainder pairs up. Nothing about which contraction is natural is built in; the caller writes patterns and the rank decides which are independent.
method.candidate_families: cubic in Riemann with the epsilon placed on the antisymmetric pairs, on split pairs, and on all four slots of one operand; Ricci-flavoured; grad R grad R; R grad grad R; and the same cubic patterns rebuilt from the WEYL tensor
method.why_summing_over_permutations: the epsilon is nonzero only on permutations, so a candidate costs D! times the free-index range rather than n^D times it -- in D = 6 that is 720 terms rather than 46656
method.up_and_down: the epsilon is carried all-LOWER, so every slot feeding it must be UPPER and the free pairs must be one upper and one lower. Nothing checks that automatically, which is why the vanishing control and the known D = 4 answer are checks rather than commentary.
method.arithmetic: exact rational throughout. No floating point, no tolerance.

controls.known_answer_control: in D = 4 at weight 4 the Pontryagin density is nonzero on every fixture and its conformal variation vanishes on every sample -- reproducing by computation what weyl_action_classification_gate asserts when it calls W_+^2 and W_-^2 both Weyl invariant
controls.positive_control: the Weyl-built candidates are NONZERO on every fixture and their variation vanishes on every sample. A complete contraction of one epsilon with three Weyl tensors carries weight -6 uniformly, so it must be invariant; if that failed, the epsilon bookkeeping would be wrong.
controls.machinery_control_that_must_vanish: epsilon contracted with symmetric Ricci factors is identically zero, and comes back exactly zero on every fixture
controls.non_vacuity: the candidate set is checked not to be identically zero -- a parity-odd count taken over candidates that vanish everywhere would be a statement about nothing
controls.non_degeneracy_per_metric: every fixture has nonzero scalar curvature
controls.rank_saturation: both ranks stop growing strictly before the metrics run out
